name: FinalBurn Neo
description: The reviewed FinalBurn Neo macOS target configures Sparkle with the akop.org appcast and SUPublicDSAKeyFile=dsa_pub.pem; its main menu wires Check for Updates to SUUpdater, and the referenced dsa_pub.pem is bundled in the project. This supports a configured Sparkle DSA key path, subject to the external framework and released artifact behavior.
limitations: New default-branch snapshot rather than historical release re-verification; Sparkle framework enforcement, appcast contents, and shipped artifact settings were not independently audited.
